cases.notes: Cut-off time, emailed tracking and a return label in the box.

listing.text: Jersey wrap dress in burgundy with three-quarter sleeves and a tie waist. XS to XL in stock. Orders placed by 3 pm on a working day leave our warehouse the same afternoon; anything later goes out the next working day. The courier emails a tracking link once the parcel is scanned. A prepaid return label is already in the box if you need it.

cases.notes: Locker and convenience-store pickup described in plain policy text.

listing.text: Washed linen drawstring trousers in natural, relaxed through the leg, sizes XS to XXL. Pick up from a parcel locker or a convenience store near you at no charge, or choose home delivery for HK$30 at checkout. Locker parcels are held for three days before they come back to us, and we email the pickup details as soon as yours arrives.

cases.notes: Refund timing to the original payment method and a free size exchange.

listing.text: Single-breasted wool-blend coat in forest green with a notch lapel and a quilted lining. From XS to XL. Unworn coats can be returned within 30 days. Once the return reaches us, the refund goes back to your original payment method within 7 working days. Need another size instead? Exchanges are free once per order, and we send the new size as soon as the first one is posted.

cases.notes: Cash on delivery from an established shop, with checkout payment as well.

listing.text: Packable waterproof overtrousers in black with full-length side zips, so they go on and off in seconds. S to XXL, roomy enough to go over jeans. cases.notes: Delivery windows, a safe-place policy and an express option.

items.title: Kids tulle party dress, dusty pink

listing.text: Children's tulle party dress in dusty pink with a cotton lining and a satin sash, ages 3 to 10. Orders over HK$300 ship free. Weekday deliveries arrive between 10 am and 6 pm, and the courier leaves the parcel with building management if no one answers. Party next weekend? Choose express at checkout for next-working-day delivery at HK$40.

cases.notes: Hemming lead time and exchanges after alteration.

listing.text: Navy wool suit trousers with a flat front and side adjusters, waist 28 to 40, sent unhemmed. Free hemming is available: enter your inside leg at checkout and allow two extra working days. Hemmed trousers can still be exchanged for another waist size within 14 days, and we will hem the replacement to the same length at no cost.

cases.notes: A hygiene return rule and tiered delivery prices.

listing.text: Cushioned merino hiking socks, three pairs in grey, moss and rust, sizes S to L. For hygiene reasons, socks can only be returned in their unopened pack within 30 days. Standard delivery takes 2 to 4 working days for HK$25; express next-day delivery is HK$45. Orders over HK$250 qualify for free standard delivery.

cases.notes: Tracked delivery, rescheduling and a self-service return flow.

listing.text: Sunray pleated midi skirt in navy with a concealed side zip, sizes XS to XL.
